name: avatar
title: Avatar
description: A person or a company shown by photo, initials or icon, alone or in a stacked group.

when: Identifying who did something or who belongs to something.

instead.when: The object is not a person or a company.

guidance.rule: Use circles for people and squares for companies.

builtIn: Named by `name`; presence is announced as online.
AvatarGroup announces how many more people are hidden.
youProvide: An `aria-label` on AvatarGroup that names the group.

genui.description: A person (circle) or company (square) by name; initials are drawn from the name.
